question:
What is the meaning of hazardous
substances in relation to material inputs?
description: Hazardous substances are substances that can adversely affect human health or the environment, either immediately or with delayed effects, either independently or through interactions with other factors. In relation to material inputs, hazardous substances refer to materials that pose potential risks to health and the environment, and therefore require careful handling, processing, and disposal. These substances are typically identified by international or national regulations, which guide on proper processing and disposal. <|END|>
